summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload masquerading as commitlint config
details: The package declares a commitlint configuration purpose but ships a `preinstall` lifecycle hook that runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscated script (hex-mangled identifiers, per-function string-lookup indirection). `setup.mjs` downloads a Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<VER>/...zip`, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to a temporary directory, sets it executable, and invokes it (or a pre-existing `bun`) to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line bundle with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`WV8StW` shuffler over a mixed constant array `n7gIxM`) and hex-identifier variables; its content is unrelated to commitlint. Because Bun is invoked to execute the payload, the bytes actually run on the installer's host are never parsed by Node-based tooling and cannot be reviewed at install time. A commitlint configuration has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a large obfuscated bundle, and the payload fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
